# roster

## `unsentRecipients(recipients, alreadySent)`

Recipients that have not been mailed yet.

Returns, in the order of `recipients` (repeats included), the items of `recipients` that do not occur in `alreadySent`. Items are strings.

Inputs can hold hundreds of thousands of entries, so the work must grow about linearly with their size.

## `allTags(photos)`

All tags of a photo set as one list.

Each record of `photos` has a `tags` array. Returns all tags of all records as one flat array, in order.

Inputs can hold hundreds of thousands of entries, so the work must grow about linearly with their size.

prompt: I need `allTags` in `src/roster.js` to scale: right now doubling the input quadruples the run time, and our import has 100k+ rows. All tags of a photo set as one list. Keep the results exactly as the README says. (CI runs it on a large input with a time limit that only a linear algorithm meets.)

## `settingsMap(entries)`

Turn a list of setting entries into an object.

`entries` holds `{ id, value }` records. Returns an object mapping every `id` to its `value` (the last record wins when an id repeats).

Inputs can hold hundreds of thousands of entries, so the work must grow about linearly with their size.
